sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
minor maintenance (P1) which must be performed every (for to six years) bases as 
indicated in the title block

The technical specification of the 
CB. Max. rated voltage = 145 kv, rated voltage is 132kv, rated current = 1250A, short-circuit current 31.5KA

The first draft is initiated and reviewed by 
eng. Soleiman Abd Elfattah Soleiman ,
accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem MPIS Hyd.EPCo.
Safety Precautions

items:
A work order must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Switch off the CB and grounded its sides
Switch off DC supply control

Switch off the charging current (D.C) motor 
 wound spring

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Portable air blower, metal brush

Set of common, Screwdrivers, cleaning material (rag, cloth), water pump, metal 
 wires
Densimeter test equipment, double open-ended spanner
Seal set to refill connector
Lubricating grease for sf6 L ... 44

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check the presence of any 
abnormal noise

Check the presence of 
surface defects or cracks at breaking unit and supporting insulators

Check the tightening of 
bolts and nuts

Check the mechanism of 
operation

Measure the bending of 
drive rod (< 3mm)
Inspect the functioning of heaters
Record counter reading of operations counter

Clean the insulations and check for defects or 
cracks

sections.text: Densimeter switching points

Open isolating terminal for signals S1 (signal 1 
"top - up") and S2 (signal 2 witch and lock) wound spring operating mechanism
Connect terminal for S1 to line tester

Connect densimeter test device to densimeter 
support
Open the nozzle of densimeter test device

When line tester reacts close nozzle and record 
reading S1/bar

Compare S1with the theoretically determined 
pressure value and repeat measurement

On apparatus side, connect line tester to terminals 
for S2

Conduct measurement for S2 according to measurement 
for S1 with repetition

Nominal values:
 * Pressure difference S1 - S2 = 0.3 
0.1 bar
 * S2 = S2 (according to calculation) 
0.2 bar

If the deviation exceeds the tolerance, densimeter 
should be correct
